s01.what: Night, a narrow London brick alley with graffiti, big wheelie bins and steam from a vent. Close shot, head and shoulders, slightly low, he leans into the lens mid-line.

s02.what: Night, under a concrete motorway flyover beside a wet road, graffiti on the pillars, a fire burning in an oil drum on the right, a car passing behind. Medium shot standing, both arms spread wide, palms up.

s03.what: Dusk, a flat London rooftop, the city skyline behind and below with lights coming on. Medium-wide standing, hands low in front of him working the beat.

s04.what: Night, the same brick alley, graffiti, bins, steam. Tight close-up, head and shoulders filling the frame, pushing toward the lens.

s05.what: Night, under the flyover, graffiti pillars, a fire drum on the left, small tents behind. Medium shot, walking toward the camera, one hand swinging down on the beat.

s06.what: Night, sitting on the pavement of the Thames embankment against the river wall, a small green tent beside him, St Paul's dome lit behind across the water, a foil tray of coins at his feet. Seated, both hands open and spread.

m12.what: Night, under the flyover, graffiti pillars, a fire drum on the left. Medium shot standing, facing the camera.

m13.what: Night, the brick alley, bins, thick steam. Low wide full-length shot, standing square to the camera, arms down.

t01.what: Day, a glass-walled office high over the City of London, towers through the windows. Close wide-angle shot, he leans right into the lens, grinning attitude.

t02.what: Day, the same high office by the window, the City spread below. Close shot leaning in, one hand low.

t03.what: Evening, a fine-dining restaurant, white tablecloth, a plated dish, other diners and pendant lights behind. Seated at his table facing the camera, both hands gesturing in front of him.

t04.what: Day, a rooftop terrace with a glass balustrade, a glass tower beside it, the City below. Very close low wide-angle, he looks down into the lens.

t05.what: Day, the deck of a large white motor yacht at sea, white seating behind. Medium shot standing, one hand raised, gesturing.

t06.what: Day, a tropical beach, reclining on a lounger under palms, a cocktail in one hand, a laptop on his lap, the sea behind.

t07.what: An underground car park, fluorescent strip lights, concrete pillars, a black luxury saloon right behind him. Medium-wide standing, leaning forward, hands low.

t08.what: Day, an English country-house garden party: lawn, a pool, guests in summer clothes with champagne behind. Medium shot standing, facing the camera.

m19.what: Grey day, just inside the glass entrance of a supermarket, rain outside. Tight close-up, face to the camera, angry.

m23.what: Sunset, a City of London street in front of tall glass office towers. Medium shot, pointing at the camera.
